 Football Tracker: Inter facing Fiorentina in Serie A, Liverpool and Man Utd to follow
 Flashscore Updated Inter Milan face Fiorentina in Serie A today REUTERS / Jennifer Lorenzini / Flashscore After another midweek of European football, clubs are returning to domestic action, attempting to juggle a busy period as we near the start of November. Our Football Tracker is the place to be for all the key coverage.
 Sunday's highlights
 • The headline game of the weekend sees Barcelona host Real Madrid in the first Clasico of the season, as Hansi Flick's side look to increase their lead at the top of LaLiga
 • Liverpool face a tricky test against third-placed Brighton in the Premier League, while Michael Carrick's struggling Manchester United host Bournemouth, and Newcastle come up against Crystal Palace
 • Bayern Munich take on Freiburg in a crucial clash at the top of the Bundesliga, after Bayer Leverkusen travel to Sinsheim to face Hoffenheim
 • Inter will look to move joint-top of Serie A with a win at home to Fiorentina, before Juventus and AC Milan take on Lecce and Udinese, respectively, while Monaco host Lille in a high-stakes match in Ligue 1
 Key updates to keep you informed
 Sunday, October 25th
 11:35 CET - A blockbuster day of action gets underway in just under an hour, with reigning Serie A champions Inter Milan hosting lowly Fiorentina at 12:30 CET .
 A win would see Cristian Chivu's side move level on points with Lazio at the summit, while the Viola are searching for just their second league victory of the season (D1, L5).
 Saturday, October 24th
 23:20 CET - That's all for today on the Football Tracker, but be sure to tune in again tomorrow morning as we gear up towards the big match of the weekend: the season's first Clasico between Barcelona and Real Madrid . Plus, we have five Premier League games to enjoy!
 22:56 CET - In the late game in Spain, a second-half goal from Julian Alvarez has handed Atletico Madrid a  1-0 win over visiting Deportivo A Coruna , with Diego Simeone’s maintaining their grip on second place as a result.
 Atleti are only two points off leaders Barcelona as it stands, and might thus be hoping their city rivals Real do them a favour in tomorrow’s Clasico!
 Atletico Madrid are second in LaLiga Flashscore 22:46 CET - Over in France, Paris FC have missed their chance to go top of Ligue 1, succumbing to a 2-1 loss at Lens , who came back with two second-half goals to win, with Florian Thauvin and Thorgan Hazard netting.
 Lens have moved into the top six thanks to the victory, with the top five all still level on points.
 Match momentum Flashscore 22:42 CET - Lazio have edged Parma 2-1 in Rome to go top of the Serie A standings, at least for the time being, with Inter to play on Sunday.
 Gennaro Gattuso’s side have been in sublime form this season, and haven’t lost yet in Serie A. What’s more, they’ve now won four on the spin, and look to be mounting a real title push in Italy.
 See the full Serie A standings here. 
 Lazio are top of the pile in Italy Flashscore 21:36 CET -  At half-time in Rome, it's all level and still goalless between Lazio and Parma.  
 Over in France, Paris FC are top of Ligue 1 as it stands, as they lead Lens 1-0 thanks to Luca Koleosho's goal just on the brink of the break.
 It is still goalless in LaLiga between Atletico Madrid and Deportivo A Coruna after 35 minutes.
 20:53 CET -  The final matches of the day are now underway, in which Lazio and Paris FC are out to go top of their respective leagues, and Atletico Madrid have the chance to close the gap to Barcelona at the top of LaLiga - follow all three games at the links below. 
 Lazio vs Parma 
 Atletico Madrid vs Deportivo A Coruna 
 Lens vs Paris FC 
 20:27 CET -  Tottenham claim a huge win at Stamford Bridge! 
 They so rarely beat Chelsea away from home, and so they've so rarely won anywhere over the last year or so, but you wouldn't have guessed from how they played tonight. Two goals in the final 15 minutes, an OG from Chelsea goalie Mike Penders and a stunner from Mathys Tel , gave Spurs a win that will mean a huge amount and that they fully deserved.
 Their life was made easier by a sending-off for Cole Palmer , but they were dominating and leading even before that.
 Thanks to back-to-back wins, they now sit 12th in the table.
 Match momentum Flashscore 19:58 CET -  Napoli and Roma have shared the spoils in an absolute thriller of a 3-3 draw in Naples .
 Roma staged a comeback to make it 2-2 with 25 minutes to go, but McTominay then scored his second of the game to seemingly give the hosts all three points. However, super-sub Leonardo Balerdi then completed his own brace in the penultimate minute of the 90 to maintain his side's unbeaten start to the season.
 19:23 CET - There's nothing to separate Chelsea and Tottenham at half-time, with both sides lacking a cutting edge in the final third in a closely fought opening 45 minutes at Stamford Bridge.
 The visitors have acquitted themselves well, going close through Mohammed Kudus and Omar Marmoush, while Cole Palmer has seen Chelsea's best opportunity expertly saved by Antonin Kinsky.
 Elsewhere, goals from Frank Anguissa and Scott McTominay have given Napoli a 2-0 lead over Roma heading into the final half-hour, while Borussia Dortmund 's clash with Eintracht Frankfurt is goalless at the break .
 McTominay celebrates scoring for Napoli REUTERS / Ciro De Luca 18:13 CET - Our attention now shifts to the Premier League's late kick-off, as Xabi Alonso's Chelsea take on Tottenham in a fascinating London derby at Stamford Bridge.
 Mike Penders starts in goal for the Blues, while Geovany Quenda comes into the attack in the absence of Joao Pedro. As for Spurs, Mateus Fernandes and Mathys Tel replace Tosin Adarabioyo and Dominic Solanke.
 Starting lineups Flashscore Elsewhere this evening, Napoli host high-flying Roma in Serie A, while Borussia Dortmund will look to go top of the Bundesliga when they take on Eintracht Frankfurt .
 17:58 CET -  Arsenal have moved level on points with Manchester City at the Premier League summit after goals from Ezri Konsa and Gabriel secured a fairly comfortable 2-0 win over Everton .
 It's also been a productive afternoon for Fulham , with Alvaro Arbeloa's men claiming a second straight league victory after Oscar Bobb 's late strike clinched a hard-fought 1-0 success at Coventry City .
 17:27 CET - RB Leipzig are up to fifth in the Bundesliga, with a rampant second-half display helping Martin Demichelis' men to a 4-0 home triumph against Elversberg .
 Elsewhere, in the German top flight this afternoon, Werder Bremen have claimed an impressive 3-2 win at Mainz , with Niclas Fullkrug continuing his fine form with a first-half brace.
 Catch up on all the Bundesliga action here! 
 Bundesliga results Flashscore 16:52 CET - Arsenal lead Everton 1-0 at the break, with Ezri Konsa 's close-range finish from a corner proving to be the difference between the two sides. Surprisingly, that's the Gunners' first set-piece goal of the season!
 Elsewhere, in the Premier League, Coventry 's home clash with Fulham remains goalless at half-time , with Josh King coming closest for the visitors.
 Meanwhile, in Serie A, Cesc Fabregas' Como have moved up to fourth in the table after Anastasios Douvikas ' second-half brace secured a 2-0 victory over Sassuolo .
 Read the full match report here! 
 Como vs Sassuolo momentum Flashscore 15:19 CET - Aston Villa have handed Man City their first league defeat of the season !
  A brace from Nicolas Jackson has given Unai Emery's side all three points at Villa Park, and you can't say they didn't deserve it. They may not have had much possession, but they took their chances and defended their own box excellently.
 Other than Jackson, their key man was goalkeeper Zion Suzuki , who saved six of the seven shots that he faced.
 City's first Premier League loss under Enzo Maresca gives Arsenal the chance to go level on points with them this afternoon - the reigning champions kick off at home to Everton in just under an hour. 
 Match momentum Flashscore 15:53 CET -  Nicolas Jackson is unstoppable!
 Man City drew level through a header from Erling Haaland, only for the Aston Villa striker to restore their lead with a great strike from the edge of the box, one that finished off a move he started himself.
 He now has seven goals in his last eight starts for Villa.
 14:24 CET - Half-time at Villa Park, and it's the hosts who have the lead thanks to a superb sixth-minute strike from in-form striker Nicolas Jackson .
 It's been a pulsating opening 45', with Jackson causing chaos in the City defence, while the visitors have also looked threatening in the final third, with Iliman Ndiaye curling against the post.
 First-half stats Flashscore 12:39 CET -  Today's early kick-off in the Premier League is a tasty one, with league leaders Manchester City travelling to the West Midlands to face Unai Emery's Aston Villa .
 Despite being clouded in controversy off the pitch, City are targeting an eighth straight win to start the Premier League season, while Villa are looking to extend their six-game unbeaten run across all competitions (W5, D1).
 Here's how both teams line up:
 Starting lineups Flashscore 10:30 CET - Good morning and welcome to this weekend's Football Tracker on what promises to be a thrilling couple of days!
 Before we turn our attention to today's action, there were several notable results on Friday night, with Ipswich coming from behind to claim a hard-fought point at home to Nottingham Forest in the Premier League.
 Ipswich vs Forest momentum Flashscore Over in the Bundesliga, Borussia Monchengladbach earned their first points of the season with an impressive 3-2 win at Stuttgart , while Torino beat Monza via the same scoreline in Serie A.
 Elsewhere, Nice moved up to eighth in Ligue 1 after a dramatic late  2-1 victory at Brest , while Alaves and Malaga shared the spoils in a 1-1 draw in LaLiga.
